reason: Wood and fire seem useful for smoking fish, so I’ll start there.
expectation: I expect smoke or a smoking setup, though I’m unsure which.

alternatives.reason: Cider and air may help with pickling, but I’ll pursue smoking first.

effect: The smoke is ready; I need to obtain fish before I can use it.
reason: Thread and rope may make fishing gear to obtain fish at the shore.
expectation: I expect some kind of fishing gear, though the exact item is uncertain.

alternatives.reason: Cider and air may produce something useful for pickling, but I want to continue toward smoked fish.

effect: The net gives me a way to obtain fish at the tidal shore.
reaction: The fishing gear was as expected.
reason: Using the net at the shore should provide fish for smoking.
expectation: I expect to catch fish, though the exact result is uncertain.

alternatives.reason: Cider and air may advance pickling, but I want to finish the fish first.

effect: The net produced fish, so I can now use the smoke.
reason: Combining the fish with smoke directly advances the smoked fish goal.
expectation: I expect to make smoked fish.

alternatives.reason: Cider and air may advance pickling, but the fish is ready to smoke.

effect: The smoked fish goal is complete, so I can turn to pickling.
reason: Cider and air is the only offered combination and may produce something useful for pickling.
expectation: I expect vinegar, though I’m not certain.

effect: The cider became vinegar, which can now be combined with fruit for pickling.
reason: Vinegar and fruit is the only offered combination and directly advances the pickling goal.
expectation: I expect pickled fruit, possibly needing a jar afterward.

effect: The vinegar and fruit produced pickles, ready to put in the jar.
reason: Putting the pickles in the jar is the only offered combination and should complete the remaining goal.
expectation: I expect a pickle jar and completion of the goal.

effect: The pickle jar completed the remaining goal and the chapter.

mostWorthwhile.text: Making and using the net was the most worthwhile sequence: it connected the shore to catching fish and then smoking them.

leastWorthwhile.text: Putting the pickles in the jar was straightforward but offered little decision-making.

surprise.text: Nothing particularly surprised me; the vinegar and fishing results matched my expectations.

arbitrary.text: No action felt especially arbitrary, though making smoke directly from wood and fire simplified the smoking process.

continue.text: I would probably continue for another chapter to see how the settlement develops, though this chapter's choices were mostly predictable.
